page.notes: Black-letter words in the entries (headwords and Old Saxon forms) are uncertain in several places and are transcribed by best reading; the Old Saxon/Anglo-Saxon forms such as "zenehian", "nenzeno", "nyhe", "nihinz" and "ful-nieh" are doubtful. The final word "tbing," at the foot right is the continuation of the hyphenated word "Nithing" carried over from the line above; it is not a catchword. Some letters in "Nequam" and "Nithing" are rendered from a faint scan.
